## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector returns (Tech, Materials, Financials up while Consumer Disc., Utilities and Energy lag) and balanced news flow (82 bullish vs 39 bearish) supporting a neutral, non-directional market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Energy under pressure with XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION and CVX (1W: -2.92% | 1M: +5.03%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +26.25%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +21.87%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology-heavy). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: OXY (1W: -3.82% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION, COP (1W: -3.98% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and parts of Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +22.69%), EL (1W: +10.46%), FCX (1W: +10.11%). Major divergence flagged: AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +4.63% | 1M: -2.48%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY — three big names with 1W vs 1M mismatch, watch for trend break; treat as tactical, not core moves.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is positive but internally concentrated; NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Sector action shows leadership in large-cap software/AI names while some mega-caps show short-term recovery.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are steady with broad participation; JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND. Sector tailwinds from earnings and positive news (V +80) confirm relative strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed and tepid this week: PFE (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth is soft and headlines on coverage/cost (LLY -50) are a near-term headwind.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay neutral and selective: favor Financials and Materials exposure given above-trend names (JPM, V, FCX) and reduce exposure to stretched Consumer Discretionary names (NKE, TJX) and utilities showing political/transaction noise. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; trade tactically around high-conviction above-trend tech winners while watching RECOVERY names for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment +80, price confirming; CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to monitor. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND — sentiment -50 confirming weakness; INTC (news -40) watch for follow-through (status: not ABOVE TREND).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Materials given concentrated leadership and momentum (Tech positive week, Materials strong). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Utilities given weekly weakness and headline risk (safety probes, regulatory uncertainty).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for continuation above its recent weekly high as a confirmation of the tech rally (ABOVE TREND continuation). Monitor MSFT holding its recent breakout region to keep momentum intact (ABOVE TREND). Watch AAPL holding the RECOVERY pivot (if it resumes 1M up, reclassify). Monitor LLY downside levels for trend failure (BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
V (+80): Visa (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND — Q2 outperformance and guidance lift confirms price strength. KO (+75): Coca-Cola (noted beat) — KO (use SP100 status if in index) showing renewed momentum; cross-check price action for follow-through. AMGN (+55): Amgen (1W/1M not listed above) — positive drug headlines supportive; watch price confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-60): Tesla (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +18.94%) ABOVE TREND — recall/recall headlines diverge from price, distribution risk. LLY (-50): Eli Lilly (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND — insurance/coverage concerns confirm downside. INTU (-40): Intuit (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION — sentiment matches recent price pullback.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk is the major divergence in large caps (AAPL, META, UNH RECOVERY) and mixed sentiment (TSLA negative headlines vs rising price) — watch for trend confirmation.
